answers.workaround:
Yes, I had no choice but to do it for my game:

```gd
class_name ButtonWithCustomCursor
extends Button
## Custom Button class that updates the mouse cursor shape to normal arrow
## when button becomes disabled
## Make sure to always call enable_interactions / disable_interactions when you want to change the disabled flag


func _ready():
	_update_mouse_default_cursor_shape()

func enable_interactions():
	disabled = false
	_update_mouse_default_cursor_shape()

func disable_interactions():
	disabled = true
	_update_mouse_default_cursor_shape()

func _update_mouse_default_cursor_shape():
	mouse_default_cursor_shape = Control.CURSOR_ARROW if disabled else Control.CURSOR_POINTING_HAND
```

You need to replace all buttons that could be disabled in your project with that new class. So better think about it early!

title: Allow setting Mouse Default Cursor Shape differently when Button is disabled
